newsitem.title: USA: El Paso Energy unit plans major expansion.
newsitem.headline: El Paso Energy unit plans major expansion.

text.p: El Paso Energy Corp said on Monday its Tennessee Gas Pipeline Co unit plans a $350 million to $400 million expansion of its system.

The Eastern Express Project involves expanding two portions of the pipeline system, from Station 87 near Portland, Tenn., to the Ellisburg/Leidy hub, and from Niagara Falls, N.Y., to the Ellisburg/Leidy hub.

The project would include the transportation services of Midwestern Gas Transmission, a Tennessee Gas subsidiary, to transport up to 500 million cubic feet of natural gas per day from existing or planned interconnects near Chicago to Midwestern's interconnect with Tennessee Gas at Station 87.

The project, with a proposed in-service date of November 1, 1999, is intended to provide a low-cost option for Canadian, mid-continent and Gulf Coast shippers to access major natural gas markets in the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic regions of the United States, El Paso said.
